The '''Keros system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Thrasybule sector/Legends|Thrasybule sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Keros]].
